body:
nine names, era by era — and every single one of them turned into songs. 🤍

that's the whole idea behind Blank Spaces on longlivets.com: taylor's past relationships laid out chronologically, each one tagged to the music it produced, with the quiet solo stretches in between getting their own cards too. ten relationships, eight single chapters — every entry dated and sourced to real reporting, no rumor-milling, just the paper trail.

my favorite detail from building it: the portrait wall shows eight faces even though the copy says nine names. one name is left deliberately unphotographed, out of respect for someone who stayed private. the count is the relationships and the songs — never a headcount of people to gawk at.

step into Blank Spaces: longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread-love-story

(pictured: Blank Spaces, as it lives on longlivets.com)

Why now: opens the Blank Spaces window's hero; drafted with today's run so its X sibling exists on the merge path. Behind-the-data facts verified directly against apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts (not estimated): RELATIONSHIPS = 10 entries (grep id: 'rel-'), SINGLE_PERIODS = 8 entries (grep id: 'single-'); kicker 'Nine names before him'; the eight-faces-vs-nine-names privacy detail is documented verbatim in the code comment at lenses.ts:208-224 (Conor Kennedy deliberately unphotographed per privacy redline #5; ongoing relationship excluded by the end!==null filter). Blocklist discipline: deliberately names NO ex and makes ZERO relationship-existence claims — the post is about the thread's construction, sourcing, and its privacy-respecting design choice, which is the tasteful angle for this subject. 'taylor' not 'Swift'; no lyrics; no AI-tell phrases.
